replies.author: itaity
replies.body:
Dont give up, just be patient. Im sure that the map devs are doing their best, but as they claimed, testing walls maps is a long process.
Do you know how much time has passed from the moment I have submitted "Wild west" and untill it got added to the rotation? more then half a year(!)
that was ofc before the map devs (and even before the maps comitee), so maybe your maps wont get added in a week or 2, but you surely wont have to wait that long.

As for what you have said about the content of your maps- its not matter how good a map will be, there will always be people who wont like it.
I personally like your maps and the uniqe innovations you put in them, and I think its a pity that you will stop to make maps just because some people dont like a map or two you have made.

Also, i have to refer to the walls YML problem.
The problem as i view it is that some things about the walls uniqe YML fields are little ambiguous (for example: the teams number, the walls regions number and type [and also the way they work]).
however, it has no effect on maps with simple YMLs (the only map that was submitted and might be affected by this is "Dark woods"), so unless there is another problem i cant think of right now, i assume that the main problem of most of the map makers with walls YML is the multiplicity of numbers and teams that might confuse them and cause mistakes, but I dont think that those mistakes are very hard to fix once you (or the map devs) spot them.
